title: lasianthus roxburghii
intro: Lasianthus roxburghii, commonly known as Roxburgh's Lasianthus, is a plant species belonging to the family Theaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Lasianthus roxburghii include its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory issues, and soothe digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
